random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a sliced section of a resected lymph node or bone lesion with a metric ruler for scale. The cut surface displays yellowish-white areas that appear calcified or necrotic interspersed within soft tissue. These macroscopic findings are characteristic of chronic granulomatous inflammation such as tuberculosis affecting the lymph node or bone.
